brief.prompt: Sales deck for Strata, an enterprise data platform, to a Fortune 500 retailer's data team.

pasted.title: Proof
pasted.text: Replaces a typical 6-month integration with 3 weeks. Reference customer: a 900-store grocer cut data-pipeline incidents from 41 to 6 per quarter and retired 3 legacy ETL tools, saving $1.8M a year. 99.95% uptime SLA. Deploys in the customer's own cloud account.

brief.audience: The Chief Data Officer and her head of platform
brief.ask: Book a 6-week proof of concept on the loyalty dataset

outline.governing_thought: Strata replaces six-month integrations with three weeks, so a six-week proof of concept on your loyalty dataset will show the result in your own cloud.
